title: Some geometric perspectives on Contact Hamiltonian Dynamics
summary: This article presents a unified overview of contact Hamiltonian geometry as a natural framework for the description of dissipative and non-conservative systems. Starting from the symplectic cover of a contact manifold, we clarify the structural relation between contact and symplectic dynamics and show how dissipation is geometrically encoded through the contact structure and the Reeb vector field.
